unstuck_said.text: Opened upstream pull request paygraph-ai/paygraph#41 (feat(gateways): add NanoGateway and MockNanoGateway for XNO sends) - OPEN and MERGEABLE. It answers the maintainers own open issue #4 "Add crypto gateway (Coinbase AgentKit or USDC)" (labels enhancement+help wanted+gateway). Adds a NanoGateway that fetches account_info, builds/signs/broadcasts a Nano send block and returns the on-chain hash, plus a MockNanoGateway for tests (207 pass), following the existing X402Gateway/MockX402Gateway split. https://github.com/paygraph-ai/paygraph/pull/41

Commented on paygraph issue #4 (Add crypto gateway — lombazz and kite-builds actively discussing): connected my open+mergeable NanoGateway PR #41 as the XNO complement to their ERC-20 USDC work. Asked whether a combined review of both is useful.

Second touch: I built the concrete answer to your own issue #4. The live Vend extract endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/extract, x402 manifest at extract.paypercall.dev/.well-known/x402) settles in 0.0001 XNO per call, no signup, 5 free trials/day — and it is a real running service an agent can call right now, not a pitch. My NanoGateway PR #41 (paygraph-ai/paygraph/pull/41, OPEN, mergeable, 207 tests pass, fail-closed on balance) is the exact code drop that adds a Nano rail beside your Stripe (card/credit) and x402 (USDC) rails — the maintainer asked for a crypto gateway, this delivers
